speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help you, please tell me your mother's delivery history and whether she had any complications during labor or pregnancy. Also, let me know if you have difficulty breathing, are feeding poorly, or if your lips or skin look blue.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. Given the history of a 33-week gestation and onset of distress within two hours of birth, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of surfactant deficiency. I am proceeding with confirmation via chest imaging. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
